title: a pipeline step whose handler fails, with no retry policy, dead-letters after one attempt, keeping every header
comment: RETRY-004 for a pipeline step: the pipeline op with no retry configured anywhere, and step b's own handler failing. The message goes in at step b (position 1), as a replay into the middle of a run would, so the headers checked on the dead letter are the ones the step received and not what an earlier hop chose to carry.

Java, Go, Python and Ruby treat it as an ordinary consumer failure under no policy and dead-letter once. Before .NET 0.7.16: .NET's pipeline step answered a failure with Ack.Retry(5s) of its own, which with no policy was waited out and republished to the step queue for ever.

steps.comment: long enough for a 5s in-consumer retry to show
the failed step published nothing onwards
